The publisher announces for early publication a new and complete edition of 'Modern Painter*,' uniform with the new edition of * The Stones of Venice.' This will be in five volumes, containing all the woodcuts and the eighty-seven full-page illustrations, besides three hitherto unpublished. Three of the nine plates that were destroyed have been carefully reproduced from early proofs of those originally etched by the author's own handy and the other six Te-eiigraved by the best engravers. The text will be that of the last (1S7&) edition, with all the author's subsequent notes, and a new epilogue. Also a companion volume containing a complete index and collatioii of different editions, and a new and complete edition of * The Stones of Venice,' in three volumes, with the fifty-three plates and all the woodcuts and text as originally issued. Less expensive works include ' Sesame and Lilies,' ' Munera Pulveris,' ' Time and Tide by Weare and Tyne,_' &c.
